summary: Russia launched a Zircon missile strike from Sumy Oblast toward Chernihiv Oblast's Nizhyn district, with a cruise missile also intercepted near Pryluky. Russian forces struck Kherson's combined heat and power plant with a guided bomb, causing major damage to the facility identified by Naftogaz as the city's main heat source. Meanwhile, in Ternopil, civilians attacked a TCC vehicle, smashing windows and slashing tires in protest against mobilization enforcement.

At least 5 missiles struck Donetsk, causing explosions throughout the city (Source: @UkraineNow/83706)
Belarus is constructing a new military polygon with rail infrastructure in Gomel Oblast near the Ukrainian border to host the 37th Separate Air Assault Brigade (Source: @UkraineNow/83695)

Russian glide bombs were launched against Zaporizhzhia and Donetsk oblasts by tactical aviation (Source: @kpszsu/74616)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a Zircon missile strike from Sumy Oblast toward Chernihiv Oblast's Nizhyn district, with a cruise missile also intercepted near Pryluky. Russian forces struck Kherson's combined heat and power plant with a KAB guided bomb, causing major damage to the facility identified by Naftogaz as the city's main heat source. Meanwhile, in Ternopil, civilians attacked a TCC vehicle, smashing windows and slashing tires in protest against mobilization enforcement.

points:
Russia struck a business center in Lozova, Kharkiv Oblast, with 10 people reported injured; surrounding multi-story buildings were damaged and a second strike followed after a pause. (Source: @UkraineNow/83708)

Belarus is constructing a new military polygon with rail infrastructure in Gomel Oblast near the Ukrainian border, including a siding track for 60 wagons and a loading platform. The facility is designated for the 37th Separate Air Assault Brigade of Belarusian SSO, described as created to reinforce the southern direction. (Source: @UkraineNow/83695)

In Ternopil, residents blocked a TCC vehicle attempting a mobilization raid, slashing tires and smashing windows. The military commissar inside was rescued by police, and the regional TCC called on citizens to refrain from aggression. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32742, @ukr_leaks_eng/32775)

Russian glide bombs were launched by tactical aviation against Zaporizhzhia Oblast and Donetsk Oblast. (Source: @kpszsu/74616)

A Russian strike killed a woman and a 4-year-old girl in Chernihiv, with a 14-year-old also injured and a private house destroyed. (Source: @UkraineNow/83692)

At least 5 missiles struck Donetsk, causing explosions across the city. (Source: @UkraineNow/83706)
Drone activity was reported in Kirovohrad Oblast heading toward Petrove and Oleksandriiske, and separately toward Znamianka. (Source: @kpszsu/74614, @kpszsu/74624)

A 74-year-old pensioner from occupied Berdiansk was sentenced to 14 years in a penal colony for allegedly sending 1,500 hryvnia to the Ukrainian Armed Forces, which was deemed damaging to Russian security. (Source: @UkraineNow/83700)

A 53-year-old woman and 4-year-old girl were killed in Chernihiv by a Russian strike, with a 14-year-old also injured. A ballistic missile launch was reported from Kursk Oblast. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71036, @UkraineNow/83692)

Two Ukrainian drones struck a Wildberries facility in Tambov Oblast overnight, causing a fire across 100,000 square meters and suspending operations; at least 16 drones were shot down and 10 heading toward Moscow were destroyed. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

A kamikaze drone hit a residential building in the village of Demyanki, Starodubsky district, Bryansk Oblast, killing the owner and injuring a local resident. Another man was injured in the village of Sopychi, Pogarsky district, by a drone explosion. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

In Belgorod Oblast, one civilian was killed and at least 13 injured. A woman died in Gora-Podol from a drone detonation, and another was seriously injured by an FPV drone strike on a car in Pristen, with her husband suffering shrapnel wounds. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

In Lipetsk Oblast, a child and an adult died and 2 others were injured when a UAV crashed into a private house. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

CIа Director John Ratcliffe may have flown to Moscow to ask Putin not to attack Europe and to stop attacks on the Ukrainian energy sector, according to US sources cited in the report. Peskov stated the visit was related to intelligence agency contacts and that no meeting with the Russian president was planned. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32743)

A Zircon missile was launched from Sumy Oblast toward Chernihiv Oblast's Nizhyn district, and a second Zircon was also detected heading in the same direction. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71016, @mon1tor_ua/71017)

Several EU countries remain concerned about confiscating Russian assets, with approximately €200 billion in Russian assets currently frozen in Europe. (Source: @tass_agency/392152)

The Russian Ministry of Defense reported that the village of Annovka, near Dobropillia, was taken by the Tsentr group. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

In the eastern part of Zaporizhzhia Oblast, the Vostok group reported gradual territorial capture along a wide front, with penetration of enemy defenses near Zarnytsia and expansion of the control zone near Dolinka, which was captured. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

From the Sloviansk direction, Russian Armed Forces are conducting heavy offensive battles in the direction of Nikanorivka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

On the Sumy direction, the Sever group repelled a counterattack by two assault groups from the 68th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade near Sadki, forcing the enemy to retreat to initial positions. Heavy fighting is ongoing near Pisarevka, and in the Shostka district Russian assault units are engaged in firefights near Ulanove. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

Glide bombs were launched by tactical aviation against Donetsk Oblast, and at least 5 missiles struck Donetsk city. (Source: @kpszsu/74616, @UkraineNow/83706)

Two Zircons were launched from Sumy Oblast toward Chernihiv Oblast, Nizhyn district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71016, @mon1tor_ua/71017)

A cruise missile was intercepted near Pryluky in Chernihiv Oblast. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71032)

A reactive Shahed drone was tracked from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast, Boryspil district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71034)

A reactive drone was launched from Briansk Oblast toward northern Chernihiv Oblast. (Source: @eRadarrua/107199)

A ballistic missile launch was reported from Kursk Oblast. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71036)

key_developments: Russian Zircon missiles launched from Sumy Oblast toward Chernihiv Oblast's Nizhyn district, with cruise missile intercepted near Pryluky, signaling a major long-range strike. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71016, @mon1tor_ua/71032)
Russian forces struck Kherson's combined heat and power plant with a KAB guided bomb, causing major damage to the city's main heat source as winter approaches. (Source: @UkraineNow/83698)

Belarus constructing a new military polygon with rail infrastructure in Gomel Oblast near Ukraine to host the 37th Separate Air Assault Brigade for southern direction reinforcement. (Source: @UkraineNow/83695)

Civil unrest in Ternopil where residents blocked and vandalized a TCC mobilization vehicle, smashing windows and slashing tires, indicating domestic pressure on Ukraine's military recruitment. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32775)
Two Ukrainian drones struck a Wildberries facility in Tambov Oblast causing 100,000 sq.m fire, with 10 additional drones intercepted heading toward Moscow. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)
Russian forces report capture of Annovka near Dobropillia and gradual advance near Zarnytsia and Dolinka in eastern Zaporizhzhia Oblast via the Vostok group. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)
CIA Director John Ratcliffe may have flown to Moscow to ask Putin not to attack Europe and to halt strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, per US sources. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32743)
sections.threat_assessment: Russia is demonstrating an escalating tempo of long-range strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure, with Zircon missiles from Sumy Oblast targeting Chernihiv and KAB strikes against the Kherson thermal power plant that supplies heat to the city. Belarus's construction of a new rail-connected military polygon near the Ukrainian border to host an air assault brigade signals preparation for potential southern axis reinforcement. The Ternopil TCC vehicle attack reveals growing domestic tensions around Ukraine's mobilization campaign, potentially degrading recruitment capacity. The reported CIA Director visit to Moscow suggests backchannel diplomatic activity amid continued Russian strikes on energy targets.
sections.regional_response: The reported CIA Director visit to Moscow indicates active US intelligence backchannel engagement focused on preventing attacks on Europe and Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to Zelensky for Independence Day, and Zelensky expressed hope that China would play a strong diplomatic role in ending the war. Several EU countries remain concerned about confiscating approximately €200 billion in frozen Russian assets, indicating hesitation on full financial pressure. Ukraine announced that two new groupings led by Denys Prokopenko and Andrii Biletskyi will reinforce positions in Donetsk Oblast.
sections.intelligence_notes: The pattern of Zircon launches from Sumy Oblast combined with KAB strikes on heat infrastructure suggests Russia is targeting critical civilian services ahead of winter, following a pattern seen in previous campaigns. The air alert sequence shows coordinated multi-axis drone activity across Odesa, Kirovohrad, Chernihiv, and Kharkiv oblasts, indicating saturation tactics to overwhelm air defenses. The diversion of a Shahed drone from Odesa toward Moldova may represent either a navigation failure or deliberate signaling. The Wildberries strike in Tambov and interceptions near Moscow demonstrate Ukraine's expanding long-range strike capability into Russian rear areas.
